## Objective
- Build a complete, playable RPG action game from the request “Rpg action games and graphics.”

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game, *Ashenfall — The Last Ember*, using canvas rendering and inline CSS/JavaScript.
- Assumed a top-down fantasy action RPG with keyboard and touch controls, leveling, consumable potions, enemy waves, and a boss encounter.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a playable game prototype and responsive HUD, controls, combat, enemies, progression, and win/lose overlays in `index.html`.
- Added visual styling and canvas-based environment/character rendering.

### Active
- Validate and fix the JavaScript before gameplay checks.

### Blocked
- Syntax validation failed with `SyntaxError: Unexpected token ')'` at the end of the script (`})();`); likely an earlier unclosed block. No screenshot or browser test has been completed.

## Next Move
1. Find and fix the unmatched brace/parenthesis in `index.html`; rerun JavaScript syntax validation.
2. Launch the page and test movement, attacks, enemy combat, leveling, boss progression, and touch controls.
3. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation; currently has a JavaScript syntax error.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `index.html` has not yet been successfully run in a browser.
